label: No infinite SERIES_OF_CAUSES_4 per se series of efficient causes of being
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise, attribution deferred, the SERIES_OF_CAUSES_4 sibling of 97f5850f: a per se ordered series of present efficient causes of being cannot go on to infinity. Every being is accessible along CausesBeingAsCaused (definition 57348ddc): here and now c efficiently causes the being of x (EfficientlyCausesIn c x esse, DEF-EFFICIENT-CAUSING at the respect of being) and does so per se, as caused (AsCaused, the per se primitive of PER_SE_5). It says nothing about series of movers or of causes of becoming, which 97f5850f (SERIES_OF_CAUSES_3) covers through c2880fe0. It is not attributed to the secunda via (ST I q.2 a.3 and q.46 a.2 ad 7 do not restrict the per se series to causes of being).
